opacity.expression: local b=0; local C={}; for i=1,#C,2 do if time>=C[i] and time<C[i+1] then b=1 end end; local p=(time+2.9)%4.3; local k=0; if p<0.08 then k=p/0.08 elseif p<0.13 then k=1 elseif p<0.21 then k=(0.21-p)/0.08 end; if b==1 then k=1 end; if k>0.85 then return 1 end; return 0
